title: Bresaola Hash with Lazy Sunday Breakfast
description: A hearty and savory breakfast dish that combines the tender bresaola with a crispy hash. Perfect for a lazy Sunday morning.
instructions: 2. Slice the bresaola into thin strips.
3. In a pan, cook the hash browns until crispy.
4. Add the sliced onion to the pan and cook until softened.
5. Add the bresaola to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
6. Crack the eggs into the pan and scramble them with the bresaola mixture.
7. Sprinkle the shredded Dutch cheese over the top of the eggs and bresaola.
8. Place the pan under the broiler and cook until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
9. Serve the bresaola hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
10. If using, cook the Sunday sausages in a separate pan until browned and cooked through.
